findings.title: `deleteCacheMutation` does not invalidate `connectedCalendars` query
findings.body: `deleteCacheMutation` does not invalidate `utils.viewer.calendars.connectedCalendars` in `onSettled` (unlike `disconnectMutation` on line 61). In `SelectedCalendarsSettingsWebWrapper`, `onChanged` is frequently not passed by callers, so after deleting cached data the `connectedCalendars` query will remain stale in the React Query cache and the dropdown will continue showing the old `cacheUpdatedAt` status and "Delete cached data" action until the page is reloaded.

findings.title: `updateMany` with empty `data: {}` will not update `updatedAt` in Prisma
findings.body: Calling `SelectedCalendarRepository.updateManyByCredentialId(this.credential.id, {})` passes `data: {}` to `prisma.selectedCalendar.updateMany`. Unlike `prisma.model.update()`, Prisma's `updateMany()` does not automatically inject `@updatedAt` when `data` is empty (it becomes a no-op or fails to touch the column in SQL). To actually update `updatedAt` with `updateMany`, `updatedAt: new Date()` must be explicitly passed in `data`.
